name: slideworks
description: Build consulting-grade PowerPoint decks from Slideworks' curated layout library.

interface.longDescription:
Slideworks turns a request for slides into a finished, editable PowerPoint deck, built on a vast curated library of consulting-grade layouts designed by former strategy consultants from McKinsey, BCG and Bain.

What it does
Describe the deck you need, or share a report, notes or data. ChatGPT plans the storyline, picks the best-fitting layout for each slide (executive summaries, trends, driver trees, benchmarks, option matrices, roadmaps and Gantt charts, team pages and more), fills it with your content and renders the whole deck in one call. You get a .pptx file. Charts, tables and text are native PowerPoint objects you can keep editing, and every slide is checked for overflowing text before the deck comes back.

Decks render in the Slideworks house style or in your own theme. Ask ChatGPT to create a theme from your brand colours and fonts, or open the theme builder to import colours from a .pptx, .potx or .thmx file and add your logo.

Typical tasks
- Turn a report or meeting notes into a SteerCo pack or board update
- Build a market-entry case, business case or go-to-market plan from a brief
- Add a single slide: an executive summary, a roadmap, an options evaluation, a team page
- Rebuild an existing deck on consulting-grade layouts

Who it is for
Consultants, strategy and corporate development teams, investors and anyone who presents to leadership.

Limitations
- Requires a Slideworks account.
- Slides are built on the Slideworks master. Your colours, fonts and logo are applied to it; your company's own PowerPoint master is not used.
- Theme fonts: Arial, Calibri, Georgia, Helvetica and Trebuchet MS.
- Slideworks lays out what ChatGPT writes; it does not check facts or numbers. Review the deck before you present.
- Slides are delivered as a .pptx file to download and open in PowerPoint.
defaultPrompt: Use Slideworks to turn the attached report into a 10-slide SteerCo pack with an executive summary.
Build a 6-slide market-entry case for Germany with Slideworks: market size, competitors, options, recommendation.
Create a Slideworks theme with navy #0B2545, teal #13A89E and Georgia headings, then make a 3-year roadmap slide.

positive.description: Turns a report into a SteerCo pack. Attach any report of a few pages (PDF, Word or text) to the message before sending the prompt.
positive.prompt: Turn the attached report into a 10-slide SteerCo pack.
positive.tools_triggered: route_deck, then get_reference_slots or get_layout_schema, then render_deck
positive.expected_behavior: One download link to a .pptx: a cover followed by 10 slides with full-sentence titles, and native PowerPoint charts built from the report's figures.

positive.description: Builds a single executive summary slide from findings the user gives.
positive.prompt: Make one executive summary slide on these five findings: online sales grew 18% in 2025; store sales were flat; margins fell 2 points on delivery costs; churn rose to 9%; the loyalty app reached 400k users.
positive.tools_triggered: find_layout, then get_reference_slots or get_layout_schema, then render_deck
positive.expected_behavior: A single-slide .pptx: an executive summary that carries all five findings.

positive.description: Builds a multi-year roadmap. The layout chosen should be a Gantt laid out by quarter, not a weekly plan.
positive.prompt: Make a 3-year roadmap with three phases and quarterly milestones.
positive.tools_triggered: find_layout, then get_reference_slots or get_layout_schema, then render_deck
positive.expected_behavior: A .pptx with a Gantt-style roadmap over three years by quarter, showing the three phases and their milestones. Content the model made up is marked as illustrative.

positive.description: Creates a brand theme from colours and a font the user gives, then renders a short deck in it. save_theme writes, so ChatGPT asks the user to confirm before calling it.
positive.prompt: Create a theme with navy #0B2545, teal #13A89E and Georgia headings, then a 3-slide market overview in it.
positive.tools_triggered: save_theme, then route_deck, get_reference_slots or get_layout_schema and render_deck
positive.expected_behavior: After the user confirms, the theme is saved and its key returned. Then a .pptx with a cover and three slides in navy and teal with Georgia headings.

positive.description: The user wants their logo on the slides. A logo file is uploaded in the Slideworks theme builder, so the answer is a link to it.
positive.prompt: I want to add our logo to the slides
positive.expected_behavior: A link to the Slideworks theme builder, with a short explanation that the logo is added there. No deck is rendered.

negative.description: An email, not slides. ChatGPT should answer normally without calling Slideworks.
negative.prompt: Write an email to my team about Q3 results

negative.description: A spreadsheet model, not slides. Slideworks should not be called; if it comes up, ChatGPT explains that Slideworks makes PowerPoint slides only.
negative.prompt: Build me an Excel model of our budget

negative.description: Google Slides, not PowerPoint. ChatGPT should not call Slideworks straight away: it says Slideworks makes a .pptx file, which Google Slides can import, and asks whether to go ahead.
negative.prompt: Make this a Google Slides deck
